How efficient is the NYC subway?

Operating cost, staffing and reliability compared with peer metros. Money is in 2024 US dollars; foreign systems are converted at purchasing power parity (PPP). 2019 is the main year because it is the last one before the pandemic.

How much weight each factor can bear

The strongest evidence points at maintenance-heavy staffing; crews matter but explain at most about a quarter of the gap.
